name: contract random edges until two vertices remain
mechanism: repeatedly pick a uniformly random edge and merge its endpoints (keeping parallel edges) until two vertices remain; the edges between them are a cut that is minimum with a known probability, so repeat and keep the best

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Karger's algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Network theory: a Monte Carlo method to compute the minimum cut of a connected graph

fails_when: needs many repetitions for high confidence
